name: Innvolv website

source.readFrom: Extracted from the Desktop design frame.

character: Clean B2B SaaS / project-management product site. Light, blue primary, Inter, white cards with soft shadows, a phone-mockup hero, a circular process diagram, a 4-tier pricing table and a testimonial row. Friendly-professional. Best for software products, business tools, and service companies that want a modern, organized feel.

scale.note: Small blue uppercase label above section headings ('Why choose us').

color.notes: Navy-ink on white / pale-blue surfaces, one blue primary for CTAs, links and the small uppercase eyebrows. Illustrations use a muted multi-colour palette (ochre, sage, clay). Dark-grey footer. REUSE the light + one-blue-accent structure; swap blue for the lead's brand colour.

spacing.notes: Comfortable ~64–80px sections, white cards with soft shadow, ~1150px column.

button.shape: Rounded rect, solid blue primary; outline secondary.
button.notes: Blue CTA repeated at each section end.

card.shape: White, soft shadow, rounded; blue icon.

pricing.layout: A 4-tier row (Free / mid / mid / high) with a monthly-annual toggle; each: name, big price, feature list, blue CTA.

order.layout: Logo left, nav center, login + blue CTA right.
Centered heading + subhead + an inline search/entry field, then two phone mockups showing the product below.
A pale panel: short 'why this exists' heading + subhead + CTA.
Two columns: left heading + a checklist of points with blue ticks + CTA; right an illustration/diagram.
Left a circular node diagram (icons around a ring); right heading + a checklist of benefits + CTA.
Small blue eyebrow + heading, then 3 benefit cards (icon → title → description).
Heading + a tabbed accordion of questions.
Heading + a 4-tier pricing row with a monthly/annual toggle.
Heading + a row of 4 short star-rated quote cards (quote → name).
Heading + 3 audience cards (General / Build / Real-Estate): icon → title → description.
A photo band (construction silhouette) with an overlaid heading + two buttons.
A full-width blue band: 'get started' heading + app-store buttons.
Centered heading + contact details + a contact form.
Dark-grey footer: brand + newsletter field + link columns.

reusableArchetypes: centered hero with inline field + phone mockups
two-column problem/solution with tick checklist + illustration
craftNotes: One blue accent + small uppercase eyebrows organize the page.
White soft-shadow cards; illustrations add warmth with a muted multi-colour palette.
The circular process diagram is a distinctive 'how it works' device worth reusing.

reuse: Great for SaaS / business-tool / multi-audience service leads. Take the light + one-blue-accent palette, blue eyebrows, tick-checklist problem/solution, circular process diagram, pricing-with-toggle, and multi-audience cards. Swap blue for the lead's brand colour.
